name: Sinchon Museum of American War Atrocities
North Pyongan Provincial Revolutionary History Museum
Museum of Contemporary Art Skopje
known: The museum's notice of its director Mira Gaćina's resignation (undated) expresses the hope that its work "will find even greater support from the Ministry of Culture and long-term partners and supporters".
Gaćina had been director since mid-2017 and resigned for personal reasons after six years.

Zlatko Teodosievski, senior curator at the National Art Gallery, told Lossi 36 (2022) that museums are limited to whatever funds the government gives and that the cultural budget was set to fall by 30 percent that year.
Director Mira Gaćina, in post since 2017, resigned for personal reasons after six years;
Tihomir Topuzovski is acting director.

name: Bergen International Festival
known: Founded by Frank Meidell Falch and Christen Gran Bøgh, modelled on the Salzburg Festival.
Lars Petter Hagen has been festival director since 2022 and leaves after the 2027 festival to run Den Norske Opera & Ballett (stated by the space).

name: Bergen Kunsthall
known: Director: Kjersti Solbakken.

Westfal-Larsen og Hustru Anna Westfal-Larsens Almennyttige Fond was founded by Hans Westfal-Larsen (1872 to 1936) and his wife; he founded the Westfal-Larsen group of shipping companies in Bergen (Wikipedia).

name: Henie Onstad Kunstsenter
known: Founded by the figure skater Sonja Henie and the shipping owner and collector Niels Onstad, who set up foundations in 1961 and gave their collection together with funds for a building and its running.
Named for its two founders.
Director: Anne Hilde Neset (Wikipedia, Store norske leksikon).
The founders' 1961 gift of their collection and of funds for construction and operation created the centre (Store norske leksikon).

name: Kistefos
known: The Directorate for Cultural Heritage (Riksantikvaren) decided in 2025 to protect (fredning) Kistefos Træsliberi (annual report 2025).

Where the money comes from: Wikipedia calls Sveaas the founder and sole owner of Kistefos AS, his investment company, and lists its investments as dry cargo shipping, offshore supply vessels, financial services, private equity, venture capital, technology-founded investments and real estate developm
Kistefos shows the art collection of Christen Sveaas' Kunststiftelse, an art foundation set up in 2019 by the museum's founder, Christen Sveaas.
It posts annual reports 2010 to 2025 with full accounts and names funders; the site names only the board chair, the register the rest.

name: RiddoDuottarMuseat
known: Its founders are the municipalities of Kautokeino and Porsanger, the foundation Stiftelsen De Samiske Samlinger (Karasjok municipality) and Stiftelsen Kokelv sjøsamiske museum (RDM annual report 2023).
The Sámi Parliament (Sametinget) appoints two board members including the chair, and Karasjok municipality appoints one.
RDM had 17 full-time equivalent positions and the director was Anne May Olli (RDM annual report 2023).

name: Sámi Center for Contemporary Art (Sámi Dáiddaguovddáš)
known: Board per the centre's website: chair Geir Tore Holm (appointed by SDS).
Deputy chair Maja Kristine Jåma and deputy Piera Heaika Muotka (appointed by the Sámi Parliament).

In May 2025 the board appointed Line Kalak, a lawyer and former assistant professor of law at the Sámi University of Applied Sciences, as managing director, "the very first Sámi leader of the institution since SDG was transformed into a foundation over ten years ago" (press release, 13 May 2025).
The board appointed Marija Griniuk as director for a four-year term, due to start on 25 July 2022 (centre's announcement, 19 May 2022).
The director and several board members changed over 2025-26.

name: Astrup Fearnley Museet
known: Founded by the Thomas Fearnley Foundation (1939) and the Heddy and Nils Astrup Foundation, which merged in 1995.
The board is chaired by Anna Catharina Astrup;
Solveig Øvstebø has been director since 2020, after Gunnar B.

name: Fotogalleriet
known: It is a member of the FUTURES photography network since 2022 and co-founded Creative Neighbourhood in 2013 (the foundation's website).
Board: Terje Abusdal (chair), Hedevig Anker, Hanan Benammar and Jan Christensen, with annual reports for 2020 to 2025 (the foundation's website).
